verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents a REST API with Journal Entries, a Get Accounts (chart of accounts) endpoint, and a Reports endpoint covering seven report types. The named reports are Invoice Details, Manual Journal Entry and Payments Collected, though, and none is identified as a general ledger or trial balance, so a developer would likely have to rebuild the ledger from transactional endpoints. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented general ledger report endpoint, a trial balance report endpoint, documentation of open output formats (e.g., JSON/CSV) for ledger exports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
